description: SPEC §6.7 E8 on Twin Roots, in round 6 (the storm at ×1.4): both Heartcaps stand at 100 and each side takes a lane on the first tick. Your Rootbreakers deal 25 × 18 × 1.4 = 630, capped at the general's 500; its Capguards deal 25 × 6 × 1.4 = 210. Both Heartcaps reach 0 in the same round, so the general wins by Rout, though you won the round. Merging is off.
